items.title: Denise Morel Interview, 1965-05-07
items.q: The interviewee discusses Bechet's influence on New Orleans jazz in France and his role in the scene, but does not mention any personal interaction, meeting, or direct collaboration with Bechet.

ctx.x: Also, you told me about the effect of Bechet on New Orleans jazz in France. How he changed.

Well, in fact, the influence of Bechet was really preponderant, because before him, of course, there was the Claude Luther's orchestra. There were some concerts with Louis Armstrong, who came to France, and who had a crazy success. But it was the arrival of Bechet in France, and the fact that he was fixed, that everything decided, that really created a terrible jazz jazz in New Orleans. At this moment, there were a lot of young orchestras who were created, who played, of course, with Bechet, and especially André…
Did you... I don't understand French, Edwin. Do you have many old Bechet records? Have you heard many of his old records?
